prose: Chance Garton, host of the InnerVerse podcast, returns to update us on his practice in biofield tuning, a holistic practice that uses tuning forks to balance a person's energy field. He shares personal stories and client experiences to illustrate the effectiveness of the technique in addressing physical and emotional issues. The conversation also touches on topics such as the power of sexual energy, the pitfalls of pornography, and the broader implications of biofield health on one's overall well-being. Listeners are encouraged to explore Chance's work further through his website and various podcast offerings.
